content: Provide continuous support to address the emotional well-being of the patient and assist with necessary lifestyle adjustments. Utilize monitoring tools, such as Continuous Glucose Monitoring (CGM) or Blood Glucose Monitoring (BGM), to track key biomarkers, including blood glucose levels, body weight, blood pressure, and lipid profiles. Modify medications as needed to enhance both their tolerability and effectiveness, ensuring that any side effects or challenges encountered during treatment are promptly addressed.
